what: Plan does not validate post-coder-head.txt chmod
scenario_or_breakage: The acceptance requires post-coder-head.txt to be chmod 0444 and cleanup-safe, but the planned 0444 test only covers pre-coder snapshot artifacts via harden_pre_coder_snapshot_perms; a missed chmod at either post-coder-head write site would still pass the proposed tests.
suggested_fix: Add minimal mode assertions for post-coder-head.txt in existing fix-applied and mav-apply test coverage, and remove the round dir afterward or assert rm -rf succeeds to cover cleanup.
